notes: - **Fixed forecast-and-attribute reporting zeros on legacy models**: the forecast path never received the 2.29.1 series-ref migration that calibration got, so models seeded before factors carried refs skipped EVERY factor and reported a confident +0.00%. `forecast_and_attribute` now runs the same `ensure()` backfill (persisted on save), and factors that genuinely have no observable series are skipped with instructions instead of a bare "no series ref". - **Fixed a units bug the zeros were hiding**: `yoy`-mode factors (inflation, USD, commodities) were forecast as raw **index levels** — a CPI t
